headline: Farranac Coast Erupts as Tempest Island Holds Busiest Hours
war_summary: The flare of the hour burns on Farranac Coast, four base actions inside two hours with Scythe the busiest works on that sheet, its losses now running past three thousand the hour between the armies. Tempest Island keeps pace close behind, thirteen actions across the day and the freshest report in the field, Blackwatch, the Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate all touched. Lykos Isle, hottest in our last dispatch, has slackened to a single action in two hours, though twenty-five stand across the day and Fort Guile and The Squall remain its most-worked grounds. Godcrofts has stirred anew around Lipsia, and Fishermen's Row stays busy at Arcadia and Peripti Landing. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their casualty ledger is the war's second grimmest; the Weathered Expanse, silent in works, tops it with more than thirty-three thousand losses in a day. This is the ninety-eighth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
